athenaOutput.directive: Architect the 'Aether Weave' — a unified creative AI and intelligent media orchestration platform that fundamentally transforms media interaction through proactive AI insights and a graph-based asset management system.
athenaOutput.rationale: DaVinci Resolve 21 highlights the critical convergence of advanced AI tools with robust media asset management and sophisticated editing capabilities. To lead, the Creative Liberation Engine must move beyond reactive tooling to a proactive, intelligent system. The 'Aether Weave' vision leverages AI to generate deep metadata, enabling a revolutionary graph-based MAM. This approach ensures maximum automation, minimal human wait time (Article XX), and establishes a self-owned, highly differentiated core (Article I), delivering a complete, non-MVP solution (Article IX) that is both powerful architecturally and intuitive by design.

options.title: Cognitive Canvas: Integrated AI Assistant for Media Generation & Refinement
options.description: Develop a modular AI inference service (ATHENA.AI.CognitionService) encompassing DaVinci-like AI tools (IntelliSearch, CineFocus, Face Transformers, Speech Generator). This service, accessible via a unified API, would integrate with existing media pipelines, leveraging specialized compute. The UI would feature a 'Cognitive Canvas' overlay, presenting AI suggestions and interactive controls as visual overlays (e.g., heatmaps for IntelliSearch, draggable focus points for CineFocus), with clear status indicators.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: High-value, differentiates with cutting-edge AI, enhances user creativity and efficiency. Cons: Requires substantial R&D in AI model training and deployment, demanding significant compute resources and high initial implementation complexity.

options.title: Omni-Asset Nexus: Universal Media Asset Management & Collaboration Hub
options.description: Design a self-hosted, distributed Media Asset Management (MAM) system (KEEPER.MAM.Core) extending 'Photo Page' concepts (tagging, ratings, albums, RAW support, direct camera ingest, external catalog import) to all media types. This MAM, integrated with RELAY for multi-user collaboration and AURORA.CloudSync, would feature a robust, custom metadata schema and smart bin capabilities. The UI would be a dynamic 'Omni-Asset Nexus', offering customizable views, rich interactive previews, and intuitive tagging and search.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: Establishes a foundational, self-owned media management layer, critical for scalability and multi-user projects. Cons: Requires significant data modeling and backend infrastructure, with careful design needed for asset migration paths.

options.title: Chronos Weave: Advanced Non-Linear Editing & Compositing Fabric
options.description: Evolve the core Creative Liberation Engine timeline and compositing (BOLT.TimelineEngine) to support advanced keyframing (bezier, subframe), HTML/Lottie graphics, multicam enhancements, and sophisticated replay. This involves re-architecting the animation and rendering pipeline for performance and extensibility, integrating with AURORA.FX and RELAY. The 'Chronos Weave' UI would offer granular keyframe control (visual bezier handles), flexible multicam layouts, intuitive replay controls, and a visual font browser with spell-checking.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: Elevates the core editing and compositing experience to professional-grade, enabling complex visual storytelling. Cons: Deep-seated changes to the core engine, potentially impacting existing features; high complexity in ensuring real-time performance.

options.title: Prism Flow: Unified Color Science & Immersive Pipeline
options.description: Implement a comprehensive, self-owned color management system (AURORA.ColorScience) with MultiMaster trim pass, advanced node-based grading, Film Look Creator, and ACES/HDR support. Extend with an integrated immersive/VR workflow (VR180/360, foveated rendering, Meta Quest/YouTube presets), deeply integrated with SIGNAL for hardware control and VERA for validation. The 'Prism Flow' UI would feature a flexible node graph, customizable HDR/nit scopes, and an immersive viewer with interactive transform controls and visual color space indicators.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: Provides a professional-grade color pipeline and positions for future immersive media creation. Cons: Color science is exceptionally complex; VR/immersive pipelines are nascent and rapidly evolving, requiring continuous updates.

options.title: Aether Weave: Unified Creative AI & Intelligent Media Orchestration Platform
options.description: This is a dual-axis approach: Architect an 'ATHENA.AI.Orchestrator' meta-AI service for content understanding, transformation, and generation, proactively analyzing media to generate rich, structured metadata (KEEPER.MetadataSchema). Simultaneously, build an 'KEEPER.MediaGraph' – a graph-based MAM leveraging this AI-generated metadata for all media types, multi-user collaboration, and advanced smart-bin logic, automating external imports via COMET and SIGNAL. The 'Aether Canvas' UI will dynamically surface AI insights and tools, offering a visual knowledge graph to explore media by AI-identified relationships, and contextual AI control panels for direct manipulation.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: Creates a deeply intelligent and highly efficient creative platform, fundamentally changing media interaction. Aligns perfectly with Article XX and Article I, offering a unique user experience. Cons: Very high complexity due to advanced AI-MAM integration; significant investment in AI research, data engineering, and UI/UX innovation; performance at scale for real-time AI processing will be a critical challenge.

options.title: Genesis Foundry: Declarative Motion Graphics & 3D Environment
options.description: Develop a native, declarative motion graphics and 3D compositing environment (BOLT.FusionEngine) inspired by Fusion's node-based approach, Krokodove effects, and USD integration. This includes a macro editor, audio-driven animation, and advanced 3D rendering (Cryptomatte, Relief Maps, deep images), leveraging KEEPER.PatternLibrary and BOLT.CodeGeneration. The 'Genesis Foundry' UI would feature a node-graph interface with a rich effects library, an intuitive macro editor, and real-time visualizers for 3D elements and audio-driven animations.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: Empowers users to create complex motion graphics and 3D scenes natively, reducing reliance on external tools. Cons: Extremely high development complexity due to the breadth of features (node-based logic, 3D rendering, animation engine), requiring significant performance optimization.

constitutionalFlags: Article IX: Ship Complete or Don't Ship
Article XX: Zero human wait time
